title: Senior Cloud DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer
summary: DevOps Engineer with expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS multi-region infrastructure, and SOC2 compliance automation. Maintained 99.99% system availability and cut cloud spend by $180k/year.
sampleStrongBullets: Automated cloud infrastructure across 3 AWS regions using Terraform IaC, reducing environment spin-up time from 3 days to 18 minutes.
Engineered Prometheus and Grafana alerting systems, reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) by 62% and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 45%.
Implemented automated container vulnerability scanning with Trivy in GitHub Actions, remediating 120+ CVEs before production releases.
